# Thomas August Ryan

> Personal website, portfolio, and blog about GIS, software development, and other interests.

## Main site

- [Home](https://thomasryan.dev/): Introduction and latest post.
- [Work](https://thomasryan.dev/work.html): Projects and professional work.
- [Posts](https://thomasryan.dev/posts.html): Archive of local and externally published posts.
- [Atom feed](https://thomasryan.dev/feed.xml): Locally hosted posts with publication dates and summaries.
- [Sitemap](https://thomasryan.dev/sitemap.txt): Public pages and locally hosted articles.

## Other resources

- [Source repository](https://github.com/uncheckederror/thomasryan.dev)
- [License](https://github.com/uncheckederror/thomasryan.dev/blob/master/LICENSE)

The demos in the repository are standalone pages, separate from the main site.
